correctness.rationale: The proof handles all possible privileged border one-counts (0,1,2,3), proves exact endpoint run equality, establishes both alternatives by explicit complete-first-return borders, and constructs an invertible two-orientation mapping to 2r+3s+4t=n-8. Palindromic counts and asymptotics follow. An independent direct-recursion checker tested 40,920 three-one words through n=32, 3000 long cases, the auxiliary two-one lemma through n=24, and generating-function coefficients through n=700; these checks corroborate but are not the all-n proof.

value.rationale: Weight three is the first content class where nonpalindromic privileged binary words exist (first example known in prior work); the exact all-length classification resolves the corresponding natural sparsity boundary. The reversible representation by partitions into parts 2, 3, 4 explains the quasi-polynomial count and the asymptotically vanishing fraction 1/(4n) among weight-three words. It is more than a finite example, simple numerical recalculation, or arbitrary slice: it completely classifies the first discrepancy between two fundamental word classes.
